item.title: ContractVille - Rent Expansion
item.description: Bring the real estate business to ContractVille with the Rent Expansion! Buy houses, decorate them with your furniture, and lease them to various tenants. Includes new property management mechanics to build your passive income.

item.title: Foolish Mortals
item.description: Louisiana, 1933. Thirty years ago an entire wedding suddenly & mysteriously vanished on the island of Devil's Rock, and with it went the location of the lost treasure of Bellemore Manor. To find it, you might need to die too. A cozy, story-driven, point & click adventure game of the merry & macabre.
